caption: The drawing depicts the head of an animal, resembling a wolf or dog, shown in profile facing to the right with its mouth open, exposing its upper and lower canine teeth. The head features pronounced fur texture, indicated by dark, wavy lines and shading mainly in shades of brown and gray. The ear is pointed and angled back, and the eye is clearly visible with a dark pupil. The inner mouth and gums are shaded darker, and there are fine lines suggesting nostrils and details on the snout. The head is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects, and there is text in red and gray in the lower right corner that reads “Clayton Clement K.C. Mo.” along with some small, handwritten numbers and letters below it.
title: Lion Head
